name: Fractal75 Analog: RCInPower GTS V3 0802 25000 KV, Gemfan 1610 2-blade 40 mm, weBLEEDfpv 450 mAh 1S HV

sources.owner: the owner's spec of 2026-11-03 for this quad (motor, props, pack, AUW, duct and canopy heights, CoG estimate, rest voltages, yaw_motors_reversed, the HV curve)
sources.HV: tests/reference/fractal75-hover.json: tools/hover-from-log.mjs on the owner's log BTFL_BLACKBOX_LOG_CHOP_CHOP_20261103_111727_BETAFPVG473.BBL (Betaflight 4.5.0, 2026-11-03), hover window 10-58 s (owner)
sources.PL: tests/reference/fractal75-punch.json: tools/hover-from-log.mjs --plateau on the same log, punches at 61.75, 93.9, 138.3 and 186.75 s (owner: 61.8, 93.9, 138.3, 186.8)
sources.IN: tests/reference/fractal75-punch-inflow.json: tools/punch-inflow.mjs on the same log (the climb through each punch, the cell IR from the hover before each run-up)
sources.FB: quadmath 992a046 data/bench/fractal75-analog-rcinpower0802-25k.json (measured 2026-09-04; provisional: kitchen-scale AUW, current sensor uncalibrated)
sources.derive: scripts/derive-fractal75.mjs runs quadmath's own functions (physicsFromBuild, batteryFromBuild, aeroCoeffs, whoopScale, whoopGroundK) on BUILD_PRESETS.fractal75 (B:103-110) and prints these literals
sources.Air65: airframes/air65.json, where this file takes a rule or an owner decision made for the Air65

confidence: high: measured on this quad. medium: quadmath data for this build, or a quadmath class rule. low: a quadmath sim or calculator constant tuned for feel, scaled from a class reference, or estimated; no first-hand measurement exists (PROGRESS.md 2026-10-22 decisions, finding 5).

mass.source: owner 2026-11-03: AUW 35.98 g with the weBLEEDfpv 450 mAh 1S HV pack
mass.note: the bench file has 35.72 g (FB:11, kitchen scale); quadmath's preset rounds it to 35.7 g (B:109)

wheelbase.source: FB frame_size_mm 75, used as the motor-to-motor diagonal as quadmath does (B:199 wheelbase = frameMm / 1000)
wheelbase.flag: not measured: the 75 mm frame size taken as the motor diagonal

boxHeightRatio.source: QP:435-436 flat-box inertia, h = 0.35 x wheelbase, as the Air65
boxHeightRatio.flag: not measured: no inertia measurement of this quad
boxHeightRatio.note: no measured inertia (as the Air65: a pendulum measurement is pending)

propDiameter.source: owner 2026-11-03: Gemfan 40 mm 2-blade; FB prop_detail Gemfan 1610, 2 blades, 40 mm

bladeCount.note: not a plant field, as on the Air65: for consumers such as quadmath's sound (the blade-pass frequency)

propsOut.source: owner 2026-11-03: yaw_motors_reversed ON (props out); configs/fractal75-ryfly-2026-11-03.txt sets it, and the log's header agrees (configs/fractal75-ryfly-2026-11-03.from-header.txt: no setting differs)
propsOut.note: not a plant field: the plant's spin table follows Betaflight's yaw_motors_reversed at boot (src/plant/plant.c sc_plant_follow_betaflight), so this quad flies props out on its own config; tests/gate-fractal75.mjs checks it

kv.source: owner 2026-11-03: RCInPower 0802 25000 KV; FB motor RCinPower GTS V3 0802, motor_kv 25000

vRefCell.source: owner 2026-11-03: HV pack, 4.35 V per cell full: the pack voltage at which the plant's full-throttle point (loadFraction, tmax) is taken
vRefCell.note: the Air65 takes 4.2 V (a LiPo's full, B:214); quadmath's batteryFromBuild gives 4.2 V for this build too (B:214), as it has no HV pack

loadFraction.source: the plant's own hover and plateau ratios at thrustExponent 1.805: the hover's rpm / (KV x V x duty) 0.706 (HV) at 0.5379 (HV derived.at_thrust_exponent.plant_load_fraction_for_hover_ratio) and the plateau's 0.583 (PL derived.load_fraction_full, 46,493 rpm at duty 0.951 and 3.355 V) at 0.5375; the midpoint, as the Air65's 0.62 sits between its two (owner decision 2026-10-23). On the pack the log had at each (tests/gate-fractal75.mjs): hover stick 0.290 against 0.289 (rcCommand), and 46,451 rpm, 3.349 V, 17.30 A at the plateau duty against 46,493 rpm, 3.355 V, 17.2 A
loadFraction.note: the plant takes loadFraction as its static full-throttle point at vRefCell (src/plant/plant.c derive()). At rpm squared the two ratios wanted 0.508 and 0.530 and 0.52 was shipped between them (this PR's first commit); at n 1.805 they agree to 0.0004

tmax.source: HV at thrustExponent n 1.805: the thrust coefficient kt = m g / (4 w_hover^n) = 0.03598 x 9.81 / (4 x 2493.58^1.805) = 6.5223e-8 N/(rad/s)^n (HV derived.at_thrust_exponent; w_hover from the logged eRPM, 23,812 rpm at 12 poles: Betaflight 4.5.1 drivers/dshot.c:56, :183, :395-399, blackbox/blackbox.c:261, :1170), times w_full^n = (loadFraction x KV x vRefCell)^n = 6123.47^1.805
tmax.flag: with n fitted from this log's onset, P6 passes by construction of n (3.346 g at the plateau rpm against the 50 ms onset 3.10 g, +7.9 %); it checks that the plant flies the law, not the law. At n 2 the hover's kt predicted 3.81 g
tmax.note: the plant derives kt = tmax / w_full^n, so this value carries the hover's kt at n; re-derive it whenever loadFraction, KV, vRefCell or thrustExponent change. As a full thrust at 4.35 V: T/W 5.06, not measured. quadmath's class value for this build is 0.377 N (derive: physicsFromBuild maxThrustPerMotor, B:176-184)

kqRatio.source: derive: physicsFromBuild kQ 0.75 (B:187, CLASS_REF[75].kQ x (40/40)^0.3, B:21); QP:306 yaw torque = kQ x thrust x wheelbase / 2
kqRatio.note: sets the prop torque coefficient kq, which follows thrustExponent: the drag torque is kq |w|^n, so yaw torque stays this ratio of thrust x wheelbase / 2 at every speed; tuned for yaw authority in quadmath

tau.source: derive: physicsFromBuild motorTau 0.0133 s (B:185, CLASS_REF[75].tau 0.014 x propRatio 1 x (1 + 0.05 x (2 - 3))) x spoolTauMul 0.73 (QP:490), quadmath's spool-up time constant
tau.note: sets rotor inertia J so the linearised motor lag at hover equals it

reverseScale.flag: UNMEASURED: no turtle log of this quad
reverseScale.note: UNMEASURED, as on the Air65: quadmath's feel constant; it sets the crash flip. No turtle log of this quad

cdAFront.source: derive: aeroCoeffs (QP:206-218) CDA_XY0 0.0054 (QP:96) x prop area (40/31)^2 x cdMul 1.578 (QP:493 at floatiness 0.32, QP:112) x userDragMul 1.0909 (H:5758, build drag 0.6 from B:186)
cdAFront.flag: not measured: quadmath's tuned drag, scaled by prop area
cdAFront.note: quadmath's tuned drag scaled by prop area; prop plane = body X and Y. Not measured

cdAPlan.source: fit to this log (owner decision 2026-11-03): tools/fit-plan-drag.mjs flies the plant through all four punches (61.75, 93.9, 138.3, 186.75 s) on the logged duty and least-squares its altitude, every 10 ms, against the log's (the accelerometer's climb speed summed, tests/reference/fractal75-punch-inflow.json traces): 0.00752 m^2, sum of squares 37.3 m^2 over 848 samples, against 4918 m^2 at the value it replaces, quadmath's derived 0.0172 (CDA_Z0 0.0060, QP:97, x prop area (40/31)^2 x cdMul 1.578 x userDragMul 1.0909)
cdAPlan.flag: effective plan drag, absorbs inflow, refit when the inflow model lands
cdAPlan.note: fitted with the plant as it is (thrustExponent 1.805, no inflow term), so it holds whatever else the plant lacks in a climb. Per punch, altitude rms 0.055, 0.274, 0.119 and 0.251 m and the end of each track -0.10, -0.74, +0.01 and -0.21 m, where 0.0172 gave 0.307, 2.509, 2.598 and 2.660 m rms and -1.05 to -6.48 m at the end. tools/punch-inflow.mjs, at rpm squared, puts drag alone at 0.0085 m^2 and drag with inflow at 0.0053. Thrust axis = body Z

skinB.source: owner's M4 instruction (Air65): quadratic drag, frontal and plan

aeroB.source: derive: aeroCoeffs (QP:206-218) = AERO_B0 3.0e-5 (QP:99) x prop area (40/31)^2 x aeroBMul 1.578 (QP:493 at floatiness 0.32)
aeroB.note: quadmath's linear rotational damping, tuned for feel; no measured value

aeroC.source: derive: aeroCoeffs (QP:206-218) = AERO_C0 2.2e-6 (QP:100) x (40/31)^3 x aeroBMul 1.578
aeroC.note: quadmath's quadratic rotational damping; no measured value

discK.source: owner's M4 instruction (Air65): quadratic drag, frontal and plan
discK.note: quadmath's chopped-disc drag multiplier is not part of the M4 model

groundK.source: derive: whoopGroundK (W:156-160) = 0.062 x groundStr 1 (W:29) x whoopScale(build).ground 1.178 (W:130), on the preset build

capacityMah.source: owner 2026-11-03: weBLEEDfpv 450 mAh 1S HV; FB packs.wbf-450
capacityMah.note: nominal capacity; no discharge test of this pack

cellIR.source: IN: the sag from the hover before each run-up to the steady plateau, on logged current: 29.6, 36.1, 30.8 and 33.6 mOhm on the four punches, mean 32.5
cellIR.flag: logged current, uncorrected: the charger's mAh for this flight is missing, so no correction like the Air65's bench 1.24 (AJ:44-46) exists for this board; with 1.24 it would be 26 mOhm
cellIR.note: the plateau tool's own IR (PL) needs its 300..100 ms before the plateau to be hover, and these punches were run up over 0.4-0.6 s, so it gives none; the Air65's 32 mOhm (its punch log, current x 1.24) is the same method

iHover.source: the motor current at hover: HV measured.amps_mean_a 2.81 A less iQuiescent's 0.429 A, logged
iHover.flag: logged current, uncorrected (charger mAh missing; see cellIR)
iHover.note: pack current = iQuiescent + iHover x (rpm / rpmHover)^currentExponent, a quarter of iHover's term per rotor, as on the Air65

rpmHover.source: HV measured.hover_rpm 23812, the rotors' rpm at which the pack drew iHover

currentExponent.source: fit to the log's current (PL current_vs_rpm, logged): through the idle bin before take-off (0.1-0.7 s: 6,420 rpm, 0.48 A) and the hover (23,812 rpm, 2.81 A), least squares in amps over the 2 krpm bands of at least 8 bins and the plateau (46,493 rpm, 17.2 A): 2.928, rms 0.23 A; the bands from the hover rpm up within 8.7 % (tests/gate-fractal75.mjs P7), the 21 krpm band 11 % under
currentExponent.flag: fitted and checked on the same log: no second log of this quad to check it on, as the Air65's freestyle log checks its exponent

iQuiescent.source: the same fit as currentExponent: the idle bin before take-off (0.48 A logged at 6,420 rpm, duty 0.071) less the motors' share there by the fitted law (0.05 A)
iQuiescent.flag: logged current, uncorrected (charger mAh missing; see cellIR)
iQuiescent.note: the electronics' current (flight controller, receiver, VTX, the ESCs at idle), drawn whenever the plant runs, motors or not

ocv.source: owner 2026-11-03: HV pack, OCV curve to 4.35 V per cell full. quadmath has no HV table, so its LiPo table (W:169-177, lipoOcv W:179: 3.30, 3.50, 3.60, 3.75, 3.87, 4.05, 4.20) is stretched above its SoC-0 point to end at 4.35: 3.30 + (v - 3.30) x 1.05 / 0.90; SoC 0 stays at Betaflight's min cell, 3.30 V (header vbatcellvoltage 330)
ocv.flag: a constructed curve, not measured: no discharge test of this pack. On this log the hover window's mean 4.07 V at 2.81 A puts the curve at SoC 0.89, where the logged mAh says 0.94; the owner's rest 4.41 V before the flight sits 60 mV above the curve's full
ocv.note: mid-curve it sits 0.075-0.1 V above the LiPo table, as HV cells do

ocvOverDischarge.unit: V per cell at SoC -0.05, -0.10, -0.15 (473, 495, 518 mAh drawn on 450 mAh)
ocvOverDischarge.source: Air65: the owner's decision of 2026-10-26 for its pack (OCV at capacity is Betaflight's min cell, 3.30 V here too, and falls steeply after), applied alike
ocvOverDischarge.flag: estimated: the Air65's shape, not measured on this pack

hoverSeconds.flag: not measured: quadmath's class rule (parity model only)

sagScale.flag: not measured: quadmath's class rule (parity model only)

ductOuterRadius.source: Air65's rule (airframes/air65.json ductOuterRadius: a 1 mm tip gap around the prop plus a 1.6 mm moulded wall, WebFPV WHOOP_TRUE_DIMS for 65 mm) applied to the 40 mm prop: 20 + 1 + 1.6 mm
ductOuterRadius.flag: estimated: not measured on this Fractal75
ductOuterRadius.note: the footprint's four duct-rim points sit at wheelbase/2 + this along the arm diagonals

hullBelow.source: owner 2026-11-03: CoG estimated about 3 mm above the duct bottom (the pack hangs under the plate)
hullBelow.note: the duct-rim points' height below the CG and the rest height on the floor. The Air65 holds 10 mm against its measured 4.8 mm because the rigid contact model flips it on every wall hit at the low CG (#15); this quad ships the owner's estimate, lower still. Where the pack's bottom sits below the ducts is unknown (measured.packBottom): a pack hanging below the duct bottom would be what the quad rests on, and the footprint has no point for it

hullAbove.source: owner 2026-11-03: canopy top 19.5 mm above the duct bottom, less the estimated CoG 3 mm (hullBelow)
hullAbove.flag: estimated, measure with pack before #15 (the CoG part; the canopy is measured)
hullAbove.note: the canopy-top point's height above the CG (the inverted rest height)

motorDelay.source: Air65: the owner's decision of 2026-10-24, the actuator delay stage off until set from a sweep
motorDelay.flag: off, as on the Air65: not measured on this quad
motorDelay.note: 0 leaves the plant bit for bit as without it

electricalTau.source: Air65: the owner's decision of 2026-10-24, the winding's electrical lag off until set from a sweep
electricalTau.flag: off, as on the Air65: not measured on this quad
electricalTau.note: 0 leaves the plant bit for bit as without it

ductHeight.note: each duct is a tube from its bottom rim, hullBelow under the CG, up this far

wallFriction.source: Air65: the owner's decision of 2026-10-28 for duct-on-wall friction, applied alike
wallFriction.flag: not measured: the Air65's value (owner decision 2026-10-28)

wallRestitution.source: Air65: the owner's decision of 2026-10-28 for duct-on-wall restitution, applied alike
wallRestitution.flag: not measured: the Air65's value (owner decision 2026-10-28)

thrustExponent.source: owner decision 2026-11-03: thrust = kt w^n, n fitted from the hover and the punch onset (the highest 20 ms mean accZ in the first 150 ms of a full-duty run) on this log: n = ln(3.346) / ln(46,493 / 23,812) = 1.805 (PL derived.thrust_law.exponent_from_onset_20ms; the onset is punch 3, 20 ms from 138.331 s; the plateau rpm is all four punches, as P6 takes it)
thrustExponent.flag: fitted on this log's two points, where the quad is already climbing (3.8 m/s at punch 3's plateau, IN): the shortfall the log puts on the climb is carried here as an exponent, until the proposed inflow model; below 1 m/s the punches are 0.994 of rpm squared (IN fits.below_1_m_s)
thrustExponent.note: the plant applies it to the prop's drag torque too (kq |w|^n, kq from kqRatio on kt: yaw torque in proportion to thrust), and the log agrees: at n 1.805 one winding fits the hover's rpm / (KV x V x duty) 0.706 and the plateau's 0.583 at loadFraction 0.5379 and 0.5375, where rpm squared needs 0.508 and 0.530 (a torque exponent of 1.81 from the motor alone). The plateau tool's 50 ms onset, 3.10 g, gives 1.691; the owner's figures (3.98 g predicted, 3.1 measured) 1.64

measured.note: the owner's measurements of this Fractal75 (2026-11-03) and what the log records, with the values the owner left open flagged

cgHeight.source: owner 2026-11-03: estimated, about 3 mm (the pack hangs under the plate); the edge-balance value was left open

restVoltage.note: the log's first frame reads 4.49 V and its idle bin 4.28 V at 0.48 A; the log ends at 209.1 s still hovering (3.68 V at 3.06 A), with its 16 MiB file full, so the rest after may follow flying the log does not hold

mahLogged.source: the log's amperageLatest integrated over all 209.1 s (owner: 193 logged)

mahCharger.flag: missing: the charger's mAh would give this board's current-sensor correction (charger / 193), as the Air65's bench gave 1.24; until then every current here is as logged
